credit: "Danse Morialta" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
description: Simple, simple, effective piano piece. This one is hard to pin down emotionally, so I marked it at both somber and uplifting. It is really quite good... though not quite Satie.

title: Unanswered Questions
credit: "Unanswered Questions" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
description: The solid beat and dark melody reverberate, giving the simplicity of this single-instrument piece the feeling of mounting tension and unease. Useful for a documentary showing pain, poverty, or imprisonment.

title: Simplex
credit: "Simplex" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
description: Thin, dark, moody piece that accelerates to the end. Remarkably metered and free at the same time. Guitar is all half muted.

title: Music to Delight
credit: "Music to Delight" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
instruments: Whistle, Bass, Guitar, Wood Blocks, Tambourine, Clapping
description: Oh, unclassifiable... this almost makes a mockery of other unclassifiable things. The woodblock player is solid. The tambourine player... not so much. Tin whistle player is delightful!

title: Beachfront Celebration
credit: "Beachfront Celebration" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
instruments: Bass, Percussion, Brass, Steel Drums, Piano
description: If you don't get it from the title, I can't help you. The bass player is pretty awesome. Sort of island-y... in a hyper-real way.

title: Junkyard Tribe
credit: "Junkyard Tribe" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
description: Accelerating piece of contemporary electronic percussions. There's some bit crusting going down, and a few other things. No melodies - just the hits.

title: Club Diver
credit: "Club Diver" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
description: Almost like euro club meets industrial vampires. I don't think I've ever done anything similar to this from the percussion side... or with those diving chord things.

title: Bet You Can ver 2
credit: "Bet You Can ver 2" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
description: Making a musical mockery using the melody from schoolyard taunts. This pieces rawks out. Nigh inhuman drumming in this. This is the faster of a set of 2 pieces with the same content.

title: Bet You Can
credit: "Bet You Can" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
description: Making a musical mockery using the melody from schoolyard taunts. This pieces rawks out. Major props to the drummer. This is the slower of a set of 2 pieces with the same content.

title: Peaceful Desolation
credit: "Peaceful Desolation" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
instruments: Brass, Timpani, Glockenspiel, Flute, Clarinet, Oboe, Strings
description: Low-key mood establisher with chords moving in parallel blocks for the melody. Starts dark, ends open and airy.

title: On the Shore
credit: "On the Shore" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
description: Beautiful, thoughtful piece worthy of character reflection.

title: Latin Industries
credit: "Latin Industries" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
description: Halting electronic dance piece that ends with a giant lush finale.

title: Loping Sting
credit: "Loping Sting" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
description: Just a quick little fun hit.

title: Pump
credit: "Pump" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
description: Longer version of the fast-paced rockin' tune from the fictional band Glory Nugget. Oh yeah, it is bad, and that's what makes it great.

title: Iron Bacon
credit: "Iron Bacon" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
description: Mid-tempo rockin' tune from the fictional band Glory Nugget. Can they play? Absolutely not. It is awesome? Absolutely.

title: Theme for Harold (var. 3)
credit: "Theme for Harold (var. 3)" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
description: Simple simple 8-bit theme. This is the fastest "Boss Level" version of the three. It was originally written by a puppet, so mostly black keys, which are easier for a puppet to play.

title: Theme for Harold (var. 2)
credit: "Theme for Harold (var. 2)" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
description: Simple simple 8-bit theme. This is the mid-tempo version of the three. It was originally written by a puppet, so mostly black keys, which are easier for a puppet to play.

title: Theme for Harold (var. 1)
credit: "Theme for Harold (var. 1)" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
description: Simple simple 8-bit theme. This is the laziest and slowest of the three. It was originally written by a puppet, so mostly black keys, which are easier for a puppet to play.

title: Light Thought var 2
credit: "Light Thought var 2" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
description: This is the faster of a pair of pieces. Useful for non-obtrusive backgrounds to ads or film sequences with voice-overs. No surprises.

title: Light Thought var 1
credit: "Light Thought var 1" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
description: This is the slower of a pair of pieces. Useful for non-obtrusive backgrounds to ads or film sequences with voice-overs. No surprises.

title: Got Funk
credit: "Got Funk" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
instruments: Bass, Drum Kit, Piano, Horns, Percussion
description: For the gentleman rhymer; funk with a bigger beat and aged effects on piano and horns.

title: Promises to Keep
credit: "Promises to Keep" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
description: Slow impromptu for solo piano. A little hopeful, a little sorrowful... I'm sure there is a word for this feeling, but I don't know it.

title: Batty McFaddin
credit: "Batty McFaddin" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
description: Gimme a C; a bouncy C! Fun, quirky, off key off colour piece with a few different feels in the middle.

title: Overcast
credit: "Overcast" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
instruments: Bass, Drum Kit, Synth, Guitar, Piano, Percussion
description: A dreamy, watery disco beat with a kick and snare that are slightly outside of classic disco. It seems like this might clear the dance floor at 3am.

title: Organic Grunge
credit: "Organic Grunge" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
description: A sort of funky, rocking, semi-swinging piece with enough dirt to make it cool. Like... jeans that were previously worn by coal miners that are sold in high-end stores.

title: Wood and Metal and Water
credit: "Wood and Metal and Water" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
description: A slow moving organic ambiance.

title: The Whip (Extended Version)
credit: "The Whip (Extended Version)" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
description: The extended version of the show theme written for The Whip Podcast.  Aggressive, hip, theme.  Slow fade out at the end.  This version can be looped easier than the shorter version.

title: No Frills Cumbia
credit: "No Frills Cumbia" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License

credit: "Angels We Have Heard on High" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License

credit: "B-Roll" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
description: Good drums, bass, and very good guitar technique.

title: Jingle Bells
credit: "Jingle Bells" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
description: Happy, clappy arrangement worthy of a 6th grade band program.

title: Noble Race
credit: "Noble Race" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
description: Full orchestra plus piano. This is a long piece with several dynamic changes. Semi-heroic at times.

title: Prelude and Action
credit: "Prelude and Action" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
description: Building piece that sets up some sweet, sweet action.

title: Deep Haze
credit: "Deep Haze" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
description: A lighter piece than the descriptors would imply. It is more hollow than dark, more motion-forward than driving. Builds continuously but slowly.

title: Oppressive Gloom
credit: "Oppressive Gloom" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
description: Moody moody dark score. Almost a death march. Loops pretty darned well - but you need to trim the end.

title: Crusade
credit: "Crusade" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
description: Written as travelling music for a video game... this is probably a bit too active for that. There is a beautiful choral section in the trombones at 2:18. Good anvils.

title: Brightly Fancy
credit: "Brightly Fancy" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
description: A lively little 2-step with interesting chords.

title: Hit the Streets v2
credit: "Hit the Streets v2" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
description: Scoring essentials. You know that one piece of music that you hear when you follow your character out onto the street, and watch them do... something around the neighborhood. That's this. This is the faster version.

title: Hit the Streets
credit: "Hit the Streets" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
description: Scoring essentials. You know that one piece of music that you hear when you follow your character out onto the street, and watch them do... something around the neighborhood. That's this. v2 is the same as this but faster.

title: Hero Down
credit: "Hero Down" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
instruments: Strings, French Horn, Trombones, Percussion, Flute
description:
A piece in three or four parts... depending on how you count parts. The penultimate section features a lonely flute, slowly joined by a children's choir, and finally exploding into a giant choral and orchestral ending.

 From the original

title: Mechanolith
credit: "Mechanolith" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
description: Superlatives abound in this giant orchestral/industrial piece. To be played loud. From the original soundtrack to "The Last Stand of the Mechanolith".

title: Unlight
credit: "Unlight" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
instruments: Basses, Cellos, Violins, Trombone, French Horn, Trumpets, Flutes, Clarinets, Percussion
description: This piece is actively painful. It is ugly and nasty and dirty - about as much as you can be using exactly one orchestra. Seriously, there are occasional bits where there are notes - but mostly, it is just... uhh...

title: Mirage
credit: "Mirage" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
description: A sort of drone-based piece with something that sounds like a waterphone, and some other things that I don't know what they could be. Super chill - good amounts of tension with some glorious consonants.

title: Death of Kings

description: Slightly faster version of the other similarly named piece, this one has an extra sense of urgency, but still retains the mystery and wonder bits.

description: This is sort of "Spooky Light". It is dark yet playful in a sense. Good for fairy tales or light tension building. It has several small arcs in it - but loops back to the begging.

description: Sort of exciting and sort of spooky in that fairy tale sort of way. This is one of my favorite pieces of late. Good interplay of instruments. You can listen to this one over and over. Handy, because it does loop back to the beginning. Major

title: Over Under
credit: "Over Under" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
description: Solo bass. Non-consistant tempos. No looping, just playing.

title: Bicycle
credit: "Bicycle" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
description: Solo bass. No, it doesn't sound like that song. There are only so many ways make a looped bassline sound. This is one of them. Ends in a super build of chords.

title: Wet Riffs
credit: "Wet Riffs" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License

title: Suvaco do Cristo

title: Lagoa v2

description: Brazilian carnival style music at an aggressive tempo. It is not possible to be unhappy listening to this.

credit: "Lagoa v1" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License

title: First Call

title: Avec Soin
